decoDesc.text: Spin it on your fingertip. The shimmering radiance reflecting off its surface is proof that the ancient contract lives on.

desc.text: A special item acquired by completing contract missions. It is exchangeable for rewards at the [Secret Sanctuary] of the [Contingency Contract] event. The item will be removed once the [Secret Sanctuary] is closed.

decoDesc.text: A device that is extremely sensitive to ambient Originium. It can boost Originium sensitivity of all weapons and devices within a significantly large area. The Triphasic Nanoflake is a key component for containing and storing the Arts, and offers better performance in non-realspace environments compared to the older Bipolar Nanoflakes.

desc.text: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: A synthetic item for detecting and verifying various field forces and actions at a distance. The tube usually comprises a time crystal sealed in a static vessel, and uses observable regression properties of the photons to achieve its purpose. Though typically stable, users should avoid breaking the vessel and stay out of areas between a pair of linked tubes.

desc.text: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: "We shall continue to honor the ancient contract."

desc.text: A portrait that can be switched to at the Profile screen. Profile portraits are shown at various places.

decoDesc.text: A special product of cut Origeometry. These stones are extremely popular due to their beauty and wide range of uses.

desc.text: An artificial material often used for recruiting operators.

decoDesc.text: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced data etching processes. Often used with other devices to effectively alleviate physical fatigue of operators during training.

desc.text: A material that promotes operators to E3 or E4.

decoDesc.text: The perseverance of life and continuation of civilization have left their marks upon this place.

desc.text: A rare material that upgrades operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge. Thanks to support offered by the Cabal of Tranquility, this carrier features data compression technology and thus stores even more information.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of EXP for leveling up Lv.61-90 operators.

decoDesc.text: A sticker acquired from the "Contigency". We will do anything to fight the Æther threat.

desc.text: A decorative sticker that can be applied to a photograph. Can be used in the Camera feature.

decoDesc.text: A crate that contains all sorts of high-quality, general-purpose materials. Operator combat performance is not limited by race nor combat experience. Sometimes, they just need a bit of inspiration.

desc.text: Opening this lets you acquire an advanced progression material of your choice.

decoDesc.text: A single-use toolset with AIC technology. Provides automated in-depth inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and significantly enhances weapon performance.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of weapon EXP.

decoDesc.text: A hypothetical condensed matter in fluid state. Though it could be synthesized and the optical properties of the resulting materials could be observed, the actual structure and state of the fluid have yet to be successfully measured. The fluid effectively suppresses Originium sublimation in all Depths that could be artificially created, making it an extraordinarily effective filler.

desc.text: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: A special coolant gel used in the essence etching process. Results of etching are extremely sensitive to temperature changes. This process thus requires the use of coolant gels, which can be extremely expensive to make.

desc.text: A rare material that upgrades essence skills.

decoDesc.text: A popular currency furnished with highly advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies. You know it's good money when you can purchase things with it.

desc.text: TC for short. This currency is recognized and used in many places.

decoDesc.text: A novel and artificial alloy of D32 steel and D64 steel that cannot exist naturally. D96 steel has inherited the excellent strength and Arts conduction properties of its constituents. It also features better performance in areas with unstable Originium activities. The material is still being experimented upon, with Sample 4 offering the best cost performance index.

desc.text: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

desc.text: A material that upgrades operator skills.

decoDesc.text: These inscriptions shall course through the Protocol Space. Every sacrifice shall be etched for posterity. This is our history. Our blood.

desc.text: A portrait frame that can be switched to at the Profile screen. Portrait frames are shown at various places.

decoDesc.text: An ion trap that might be leveraging its innate Æther properties. The lattice ignores temporal factors and is capable of detecting and screening naturally occurring tachyon beams in realspace. Since the people of Talos-II are still incapable of activating and firing tachyons, the lattice is thus essential for any experiments involving random outcome solidification.

desc.text: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.

decoDesc.text: A heavy casting die made using rare materials. Techno-Protocol activation lets this die enhance general material strengths in weapons.

desc.text: A material that tunes weapons.
